# Fixture Client tokens and rules

Hand-written by the client. The token file wins over anything below.

## Palette

- **Primary:** #1C64D9 (brand.primary)
- **Text:** #1E2329 (text.primary)

## Type

- **Family:** Fixture Sans
- **Label tracking:** 0

| Role | Token |
|---|---|
| Primary | brand.primary |
| Text | text.primary |

## Rules

- Labels are sentence case at zero tracking.
- Never recolor the logo.
